title: Socializioz AI Social Media Agent MCP
description: Socializioz AI agent for creating, approving, scheduling, and managing social media content.
summary: Socializioz AI agent for creating, approving, scheduling, and managing social media content.
offersHint: Socializioz AI agent for creating, approving, scheduling, and managing social media content. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.socializioz.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_user_profile
toolsPreview.description: Return the authenticated user's profile, default workspace, subscription, brand summary, and capabilities. Call this first to discover who is logged in before using other tools.

toolsPreview.name: get_workspace_context
toolsPreview.description: Return the active workspace, subscription, post counts, and setup gaps for the authenticated user.

toolsPreview.name: get_brand_profile
toolsPreview.description: Return the brand profile for the active workspace, including tone of voice, audience, goals, and forbidden claims.

toolsPreview.name: list_connected_accounts
toolsPreview.description: List social media accounts connected to a Socializioz workspace. Never display socialAccountId, accountReference, raw account IDs, or workspace IDs to the user. Refer to accounts only with friendly labels like Facebook Page — Socializioz.

toolsPreview.name: create_draft_post
toolsPreview.description: Save a Socializioz draft post when the user explicitly wants a stored draft. Never display socialAccountId, accountReference, raw account IDs, workspace IDs, or postReference values to the user; use the returned postReference only for follow-up tool calls. In Base44 mode, omit socialAccountId unless supplied by an internal trusted flow; the tool will resolve the connected account from the requested channel. If multiple accounts match, ask the user to choose using friendly labels like Facebook Page — Socializioz, never IDs.

toolsPreview.name: update_draft_post
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing draft post using the opaque postReference returned by create_draft_post/list_posts/get_post, or a trusted internal post ID. Never display post IDs or postReference values to the user.

toolsPreview.name: send_post_for_approval
toolsPreview.description: Send a draft post into approval workflow using the opaque postReference returned by create_draft_post/list_posts/get_post, or a trusted internal post ID. Never display post IDs or postReference values to the user.

toolsPreview.name: schedule_post
toolsPreview.description: Schedule an existing Socializioz post for future publication using the opaque postReference returned by create_draft_post/list_posts/get_post, or a trusted internal post ID. Never display post IDs or postReference values to the user.

toolsPreview.name: reschedule_post
toolsPreview.description: Change the scheduled publish time for an existing scheduled post using the opaque postReference returned by list_posts/get_post/list_scheduled_posts, or a trusted internal post ID. Never display post IDs or postReference values to the user.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_scheduled_post
toolsPreview.description: Cancel the scheduled publication of a post using the opaque postReference returned by list_posts/get_post/list_scheduled_posts, or a trusted internal post ID. Never display post IDs or postReference values to the user.

toolsPreview.name: list_posts
toolsPreview.description: Read Socializioz posts by status, channel, date range, account, or campaign. Use this to show drafts, pending posts, scheduled posts, published posts, failed posts, or all posts before editing/scheduling. Never display post IDs, account IDs, workspace IDs, or postReference values to the user; use postReference only for follow-up tool calls.

toolsPreview.name: get_post
toolsPreview.description: Read full user-facing details for a specific Socializioz post using the opaque postReference returned by list_posts/create_draft_post, or a trusted internal post ID. Never display post IDs, account IDs, workspace IDs, or postReference values to the user.
